name: Motion showreel built from scratch: a bouncing keyframe ball, two blooms, a shape morph chain and a 0.2 s montage

source.creator: unknown

rights.attribution: Unknown creator; supplied by the user as a private study reference.

brand_assets.description: Name with a full stop on the end card
Lime ball character with a face

rights.notes: Rights unverified. A personal showreel; reuse the progression structure, blooms and montage timing only, with original designs.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session F) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames), transitions strips at all 7 boundaries (every 2nd frame), the listen sheet (1 phrase, 12 accent hits); strips at 0.30-1.90 s (15 fps) and 11.20-13.30 s (30 fps, 11 montage cuts). Signal features and Windows en-US dictation; nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 15.0 s (1280x720, 60 fps); boundaries at 2-frame steps; the opening and the montage at 15-30 fps.

concept.observed: A motion designer's showreel that starts from a single bouncing keyframe ball and moves through what the designer can do: type, shape morphs, flow fields, particles, a character, a montage of styles, and the name.
concept.interpreted: Craft shown as a progression from the simplest animation to a full style range.

communication_style.observed: Music only; giant condensed caps for the few words.

palette.observed: Black (34%), ultramarine (#2838f8, 14%), vermilion (#f84828, 11%), cream, lime; each section takes one or two of them.

typography.observed: Heavy condensed grotesque caps (statement and section words); a chromatic-split word; a lower-case heavy sans name with an orange full stop at the end.

composition.observed: Centred subjects; a keyframe-editor ruler and HUD corner brackets with tiny labels frame most sections.

motion.observed: Ball bounces on the ruler with dotted arc trails, contacts at about 0.50, 0.97 and 1.43 s; blob -> square -> triangle -> star -> flower morphs on a halftone field (4.1-5.5 s); flow-field lines form a word (5.6-7.1 s); a particle sphere becomes a torus and breaks up (7.8-9.1 s); a lime ball squashes, winks and leaps out (9.4-11.2 s); the name types in letter by letter with a bounce (13.14-13.30 s).

transitions.observed: 1.85 s grow: the ball rises and grows into the full orange frame in 0.10 s (1.76-1.86 s). 3.42 s cover: square pixel blocks dissolve from the top-right while a black ball rolls in (3.33-3.60 s). 5.63 s cut to the dark flow field. 9.35 s grow: a blue circle blooms from the centre in 0.10 s (9.26-9.36 s). 11.27-13.03 s: a montage of 11 cards, 0.10-0.27 s each (the detector found 2 of these cuts at its 8 fps scan). 13.03 s: one light-grey frame, 0.1 s of dark, then the name.
transitions.interpreted: Two blooms of 0.10 s open the two big sections; the montage is the climax.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Sections of 1.5-2.0 s, then the montage at 0.10-0.27 s per card (median 0.13 s), then a 2 s name card.

sound_design.observed: -13.2 LUFS, LRA 0.6 LU (the most compressed in batch 6), true peak -0.9 dBTP; tempo 64.6 bpm (medium); 64 onsets; 13 accents (52/min). Accents on boundaries 2 of 7 (0.29, chance 0.16); onsets within 50 ms of boundaries 0.29 (chance 0.35). The strongest accents land on the ball's contacts (0.51, 0.98, 1.46 s), on shape changes (4.27, 5.22 s), then 1.86-1.88 s apart on section events (5.22, 7.08 the word forms, 8.96 the torus breaks, 10.84 the wink), and in the montage 0.23-0.24 s apart (11.54, 11.77, 12.00, 12.24 s), each within 0-40 ms of a montage cut (11.50, 11.77, 11.97, 12.20 s); 13.17 s the name types. No silences; head -6.9 dB, tail -6.3 dB. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Outside the montage, sound follows the action (bounces, morphs); in the montage the cut is the event and lands on the accent.

narration.observed: None: dictation kept 1 confident word (7 raw), a single phrase over the pixel wipe and the shape morphs (3.43-4.80 s).
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: No captions. Copy is the picture: a three-line centred statement in giant caps (1.93-3.4 s), single section words, the name centred at the end with an orange full stop.

scenes.observed: A ball bounces along a keyframe ruler.
Orange bloom; a three-line statement in giant caps.
Pixel wipe to cream; a shape morph chain on a halftone field.
Flow field forms a word; particle sphere to torus.
Blue bloom; a lime ball character squashes and winks.
Flash frame; the name types in; end card.

moments.observed: The bouncing ball rises to the centre and grows into a full orange frame in 0.10 s (1.76-1.86 s).
moments.interpreted: The simplest animation (a bounce) becomes the stage for everything else.

difficult: Flow-field and particle sections need Canvas 2D or WebGL; the torus of particles reads as 3D
uncertainties: Durations of the shortest montage cards (30 fps strip, 60 fps source: +/- 17 ms)
Whether the end-card name is a person's name or a brand
